671:t_104:11.en:

671:t_105:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Sorry... but I can't relate to anything you're saying.」

671:t_105:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Naturally. A mere Wingless could never understand my love.」

671:t_105:3.en:
$$葵$$
「But the love I dream of isn't the kind that makes other people unhappy, like yours!」

671:t_105:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Neither of us understands love, so let's settle this with strength! Fight me, fallen $$天翅$$!」

671:t_106:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「I've lived a decent while myself! I've seen all kinds of lovers, believe it or not!」

671:t_106:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Pitiful. You only watch, and can't grasp a love of your own?」

671:t_106:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「If love means dragging others into misery out of jealousy and spite like you do, I don't want it!」

671:t_106:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A mere Wingless denies my love... my feelings!?」

671:t_106:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「I may not understand love between a man and a woman, but I have a heart that loves justice! I'll use it to stop your rampage!!」

671:t_107:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It may sound like I'm denying my own profession, but I will refrain from discussing love with you.」

671:t_107:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「At least you seem to know your place.」

671:t_107:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is not it. It is because a man with love as twisted as yours is no one to debate with.」

671:t_107:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then how will you settle this battle?」

671:t_107:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Reluctantly, I will use force!」

671:t_107:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Indeed! This is the result your twisted love brought upon you... know that you have only yourself to blame!」

671:t_108:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Winged dog! Stop clinging to me!」

671:t_108:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're a relic of the past, you know that!」

671:t_108:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$アポロ$$ is no winged dog! He's a human!」

671:t_108:4.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Shake off the past, $$ミカゲ$$! Time flows toward the future!」

671:t_108:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! I live with the memories of love and of hatred, and I will wrap the future in despair!」

671:t_108:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then we'll make you shake off the past, by force if we have to!」

671:t_108:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Wake up, $$ミカゲ$$! I won't hand the world over to your despair!」

671:t_109:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Winged dog! Your filthy love will be painted over by my despair!」

671:t_109:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Try it if you can! My love with $$ミコノ$$ will never lose to the likes of you!」

671:t_109:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have lived through a vast span of time, piling up my despair! You, who have lived a mere dozen-odd years, could never understand it!」

671:t_109:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But I swear eternity! With $$ミコノ$$!」

671:t_109:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Strong...! Even stronger than when we fought before...!」

671:t_109:6.en:
$$カグラ$$
「This guy's love for $$ミコノ$$ is bottomless. Even I'd tuck my tail and run!」

671:t_109:7.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Exactly, $$ミカゲ$$! No matter how you threaten him, $$アマタ$$ will never run!」

671:t_109:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I have $$ミコノ$$! I have my friends! They give me strength!」

671:t_109:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Here I come, $$ミカゲ$$! I'm $$アマタ・ソラ$$... just a human!」

671:t_109:11.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But my love with $$ミコノ$$ won't lose to anyone!!」

671:t_110:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A Wingless trembling with guilt... Shall I put you out of your misery right now?」

671:t_110:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Dying won't solve anything... So I...!」

671:t_110:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I sense a strong will from this frail Wingless!」

671:t_110:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
(It's all right, $$シンジ$$... I want to support you as you are...)

671:t_110:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away! So... so I...!」

671:t_111:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The world that $$ティファ$$ and I love! I won't lose to anyone who tries to wrap it in despair!」

671:t_111:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What is this feeling that supports this person...!?」

671:t_111:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't you get it!? This is $$ティファ$$'s and my love!」

671:t_111:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Impossible! That I, of all beings, should be overwhelmed by a Wingless's love!」

671:t_111:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「As long as $$ティファ$$ is with me, I'm invincible! I won't lose to anyone, no matter who it is!」

671:t_111:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You kept going on about love, so I'll show you how strong our love is!!」

671:t_112:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I remember you too. The one the Moon Queen entrusted with the power of the $$月光蝶$$.」

671:t_112:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... will you bury a civilization again? Not that the $$御使い$$s have already set their eyes on that planet.」

671:t_112:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$月光蝶$$'s rampage was... to destroy civilization and stop humanity's evolution...」

671:t_112:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Exactly. That $$黒歴史$$ was the result of Wingless fleeing from a future of despair.」

671:t_112:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But now it's different...! We won't paint the future black!」

671:t_112:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So I'll fight you too! And I'll make sure we escape from this space!」

671:t_112:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How admirable, Wingless. Then I shall give you despair.」

671:t_113:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you realize? That your very existence invited the $$御使い$$s.」

671:t_113:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even without me, someone else would have awakened as a $$ニュータイプ$$. No one can stop humanity from moving forward.」

671:t_113:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But what awaits beyond that is despair.」

671:t_113:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Fighting to cast that off is our duty!」

671:t_113:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't hand it over to you or the $$御使い$$s! Humanity's future belongs to humanity!」

671:t_114:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Someone who refuses to recognize others' lives has no right to talk about love! The world... the universe should be filled with life!」

671:t_114:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This Wingless... is drawing near the truth...!」

671:t_114:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「As I thought, your existence cannot be allowed...! I will dispose of you before the $$御使い$$s can!」

671:t_114:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I won't follow such ego! Life... is free!」

671:t_115:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Those who pluck out possibilities...! They are the ones we must fight!」

671:t_115:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A futile struggle. What awaits you is the $$御使い$$s... in other words, a future of despair.」

671:t_115:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But... even so! We keep moving forward! That's what being alive means!」

671:t_115:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You say that in front of me, who lives with despair... I shall give you a punishment.」
